description:
Wellness Coach provides instant access to a curated library of expert-led wellness content covering mental health, emotional wellbeing, physical health, mindfulness, stress management, sleep, nutrition, and personal growth.

Use Wellness Coach when you want trusted, structured wellness content — including stress relief sessions, anxiety support, mindfulness practices, sleep guidance, and personal growth programs — delivered by experienced instructors.

The app searches a highly rated on-demand content library and surfaces the most relevant wellness videos based on your question, helping you move from concern to action with practical guidance.

defaultPrompt: Wellness Coach please suggest me yoga videos
Wellness Coach Please suggest Sleep meditations for anxiety
